```typescript
// Example: Initiating an agent login session and checking its status.
async function checkAgentSession() {
  const sessionResponse = await client.getMyPlaceAsyncSession();

  if (sessionResponse.status === 'pending') {
    console.log('Agent login session is still pending.');
  } else if (sessionResponse.status === 'complete') {
    console.log('Agent login session is complete.');
  } else {
    console.log('Agent login session failed or is in an unknown state.');
  }
  return sessionResponse;
}
```

```typescript
// Example: Retrieving property listings based on specific criteria.
async function getPropertyListings() {
  const propertyData = await client.getCv({
    location: 'London',
    propertyType: 'house',
    minPrice: 500000,
    maxPrice: 1000000,
  });

  if (propertyData && propertyData.listings) {
    console.log(`Found ${propertyData.listings.length} properties.`);
    // Process the property listings here
    propertyData.listings.forEach((listing) => {
      console.log(`- ${listing.title}: £${listing.price}`);
    });
  } else {
    console.log('No properties found matching the criteria.');
  }
  return propertyData;
}
```
